answer: Each identity plants a lotus at the harbor registry, locking 70 credits for 3 glacier milestones. Each epoch a glacier melt-line advances; the keeper must show a harbor-stamped proof before it passes. A missing proof burns the bond. First 45, kth 45+6(k-1): harbor masters stamp max 3 per epoch, so 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 against 40,000 rewards. Rented stamps fail: each milestone needs a new harbor cluster. Honest keepers pay 45 once.
